An ill-fated reconnaissance '''mission''' on the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] was undertaken by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During the operation, the Alliance cell charged with the mission accidentally gave away its position to [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]] on the planet. The Empire then reacted to the Rebel presence with heavy fire, prompting the mission's Rebel command to evacuate and abandon the unit to its own devices. A [[Scout/Legends|scout]] named [[Sasha]] was the sole survivor of her group and had her loyalty to the Alliance shattered after the ordeal.

==Prelude==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="Folio" /> a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide conflict between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the splinter [[Politics/Legends|political]] faction known as the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] was strategically significant to the Empire. The planet was the site of [[Jyrenne Base]], the most important Imperial [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] ordnance center in the [[Japrael sector/Legends|Japrael sector]]; the base was situated near<ref name="Galaxywide Newsnets">{{JournalCite|10|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref> the walled [[City/Legends|city]]<ref name="TEA" /> of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]].<ref name="Galaxywide Newsnets" />

==The mission==
[[File:Sasha_the_explorer.png|thumb|right|180px|Sasha, the sole survivor of her unit]]
Sometime during the galactic war, the Alliance decided to conduct a reconnaissance mission on Onderon, sending a Rebel cell to gather information on the Empire's presence on the planet. During the operation, the Rebel unit accidentally gave away its position to [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]] while its members defended themselves with [[Blaster/Legends|blasterfire]] against Onderon's dangerous native wildlife. The Imperials, now aware of the Rebel presence on the planet, responded with heavy [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] and sent a strike force of [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transports]] to the intruders' last known position. The recon team's misstep was critical, as it led to the Rebel command's decision to leave the reconnaissance detachment on its own without any further support. Of those in the unit under fire, only a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] named [[Sasha]] survived.<ref name="Folio" />

==Aftermath==
Sasha, the only survivor of her unit, went into hiding in the planet's hinterlands, remaining stranded on Onderon for some [[Time/Legends|time]]. The Alliance's abandonment of her unit broke Sasha's longstanding loyalty to the Rebellion.<ref name="Folio" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mission was first mentioned in [https://images-cdn.fantasyflightgames.com/ffg_content/StarWarsRPG/edge-of-the-empire/beginner-game/Support/Bonus%20Adventure/High%20Rez/Character_Folio_Sasha_HR.pdf Sasha Character Folio], a freely downloadable character sheet for ''[[The Long Arm of the Hutt]]'', a bonus adventure for the [[roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Beginner Game|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Beginner Game]]. The game was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] as part of the [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire|''Edge of the Empire'']] RPG series. The supplement material was made available by Fantasy Flight as a free [[Wikipedia:Portable Document Format|PDF eBook]] from its website in [[December]] [[2012]].<ref name="FFG">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2012/12/14/the-long-arm-of-the-hutt|text=The Long Arm of the Hutt}}</ref> The last page of the Character Folio elaborates on Sasha's backstory, as well as her participation during the reconnaissance mission to Onderon.<ref name="Folio" />
